name: FormNET
title: the network tab for your whole computer
summary: FormNET is a network inspector with flows, hosts and every open connection with the process behind it, in one window with no account. Local only.
lede: FormNET is the network tab for your whole computer. It shows flows through its local proxy, totals per host and every connection the machine holds with the process that owns it, in one window with no account. Both listeners bind loopback only and recordings stay in memory until you export them.
checks: Shows every request in full: headers, bodies up to a limit, sizes, timings and the TLS that was negotiated.
Groups flows by host with requests, errors and bytes each way, and labels widely documented third parties as a reading aid, never a verdict.
Lists every connection the computer holds with the process that owns it.
Keeps both listeners on loopback only and holds recordings in memory until you export them.

facts.dd: Four: Flows, Hosts, Machine and Setup
HAR 1.2 of any filtered view, and a machine snapshot as JSON
A Go 1.26 server with the TypeScript and Vite client embedded, and a Tauri 2 window around the same binary
82 Go tests and a Playwright window smoke in CI

chapters.title: Every request, in full
chapters.text: Click a flow to read what was sent and what came back. Opaque tunnels are still counted by host and bytes.

chapters.title: Who it talks to
chapters.text: Requests, errors and bytes each way per host. Widely documented third parties get a reading-aid label, never a verdict.

chapters.title: Not one page and not one proxy
chapters.text: Every connection the computer holds, with the process that owns it. The process column in Flows is filled only where the platform reports it.

features.title: Flows
features.text: A live table of requests through the proxy, with the selected request's headers and body beside it.
bullets: Headers, bodies up to a limit, sizes and timings
The TLS that was negotiated
Opaque tunnels counted by host and bytes

features.title: Failed requests
features.text: Select a failed request to read its response headers and error body.
bullets: Response headers and body in the detail pane

features.title: Hosts
features.text: Flows grouped by host with the totals that matter.
bullets: Requests, errors and bytes each way
Reading-aid labels for widely documented third parties
An unlabelled host is simply not on the list

features.title: Machine
features.text: Every connection the computer holds, with the process behind it.
bullets: ./bin/formnet snapshot prints the connection table once as JSON

features.title: Proxy
features.text: A local proxy you point a program at.
bullets: Plain HTTP forwarding and CONNECT tunnels
TLS interception with a local root
Passthrough patterns

features.title: Local root certificate
features.text: The certificate is made on first run and HTTPS is opened only once you trust it.
bullets: The private key never leaves ~/formnet
Until trusted, HTTPS is tunnelled and counted but not opened
./bin/formnet ca trust prints the command that trusts it for your user only

features.title: Export
features.text: Take a recording out when you choose to.
bullets: HAR 1.2 of any filtered view
Machine snapshot as JSON

features.title: Agents and scripts
features.text: Scripts read the same recording over a token-guarded local API.
bullets: ./bin/formnet snapshot and ./bin/formnet ca
/api/flows, /api/flows/{id}, /api/hosts, /api/machine, /api/export/har and /api/stream

features.title: Nothing leaves
features.text: The proxy and the API refuse any other address than loopback.
bullets: The proxy never connects to loopback through a host name
Recordings stay in memory until exported
Client and API on 127.0.0.1:8760, proxy on 127.0.0.1:8761

docs.agents: ./bin/formnet snapshot prints the connection table as JSON and ./bin/formnet ca prints the root certificate path, fingerprint and trust state. Other scripts call the local API with the token from ~/formnet/token. See AGENTS.md.

topics.title: Point a program at the proxy
topics.text: For example curl -x http://127.0.0.1:8761 http://example.com/. Until the computer trusts the root, HTTPS is tunnelled and counted but not opened.

topics.title: Settings
topics.text: Settings are FORMNET_* environment variables, such as FORMNET_DATA, FORMNET_PASSTHROUGH and FORMNET_INTERCEPT. ./bin/formnet help lists them all.

topics.title: Client development
topics.text: cd web && npm ci && npm run dev serves the client on http://localhost:5176, proxied to a running formnet.

topics.title: Status
topics.text: Early (v0.1). The desktop window source has not been compiled yet, and the process column in Flows is filled only where the platform reports it.

topics.title: Releases
topics.text: FormNET builds are compiled and released from FormCompiler; the repository holds the source.
